newsitem.title: CHINA: China forex market volume up 21 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: China forex market volume up 21 pct in March.

text.p: Volume on China's Shanghai-based national foreign exchange market rose 21 percent to $4.576 billion equivalent in March against February, the China Securities newspaper said on Monday.
The market, the China Foreign Exchange Trade System, only trades the U.S. dollar, the Hong Kong dollar and the Japanese yen against the Chinese yuan.
The breakdown was US$4.13 billion, HK$2.97 billion and 6.6 billion Japanese yen, the newspaper said.
